idea.idea: Stop Typing Invoices: The Mobile OCR Stack for Indian Traders
idea.angle: Why manual entry from paper delivery challans and vendor bills is destroying your cash cycle—and how free mobile OCR tools turn physical slips into Excel/Tally rows in 10 seconds.
idea.audience_problem: Indian traders and retail shop owners waste 2-3 hours daily manually typing vendor bills and purchase receipts into spreadsheets.

hooks: Are you still typing supplier bills into your computer by hand?
Stop wasting hours every day copying paper invoices into your tally software.
Your manual data entry is killing your business cash flow.
piece.hook_reason: It addresses the specific pain point of the target audience (traders/shop owners) and highlights a direct, time-consuming business problem.
piece.title: Stop Typing Invoices: The Mobile OCR Stack

scenes.narration: Stop wasting hours every day copying paper invoices into your tally software.
Use a mobile OCR app. It turns a photo of a physical bill into digital text instantly.
Adobe Scan is a reliable choice. It recognizes text and handles different document types like receipts or ID cards.
Be careful though. Folded, torn, or faded receipts can confuse the app. It works best on crisp, black text.
Check your existing phone apps first. Many already have built-in scanning features before you download anything new.

piece.caption: Stop manual data entry for your shop or business. Using mobile OCR scanning apps turns paper delivery challans and vendor bills into editable text in seconds. You don't need a heavy desktop scanner to digitize your records. Start by testing your current phone camera or a free tool like Adobe Scan. Remember, OCR isn't magic; it struggles with crumpled or faded paper, so keep your source documents flat for the best results.
